ui.emptyItems: Nothing yet. Tap glowing things to pick them up.
ui.mapSub: Each room you finish lights one Route Mark.
ui.hintLogEmpty: You have not used a hint.
ui.hintTooEarly: Look around first. Tap the glowing things and the puzzle will open.
ui.useNothing: Open your Journal and pick an item first.
ui.timeUpText: The walls moved before you reached the Door.
ui.sconceDark: It is too dark to see.
ui.fallbackRoom: Picture missing. Showing a plain room.
ui.hintNeedPoints: You need {hint} Tallies for a hint.
ui.hintLearn: A glowing note is {dir}. Tap it to read it.
ui.hintUseItem: Open your Journal and pick the {item}. Then tap the {label} {dir}.
ui.hintNeedItem: You still need the {item}. Look around the room for it.
ui.hintNothing: Look around the room again. Turn all the way around.

mission.heading: THE LAST LABYRINTH
paragraphs: Stone walls rise around the Hollow Court. Every dusk they turn, and the maze becomes a new maze that nobody has ever mapped twice.
You are Ren. You woke yesterday with no memory. Dessa, the best Runner of all, found the Last Door two dusks ago and then vanished.
With Tali, follow Dessa's Journal through seven rooms and reach the Door. You have ten minutes before the Turning.

tutorial.title: Look around
tutorial.text: Drag to turn. Pinch or scroll to zoom.

tutorial.title: Tap what glows
tutorial.text: Pick up items, read notes, and look closely at things. Gold glows teach you something.

tutorial.title: Your Journal
tutorial.text: Your Journal keeps your items, your notes, the Runner's Map and your hints. Pick an item there to use it.

tutorial.title: Puzzles
tutorial.text: Every puzzle has Close and Pause buttons. A wrong answer locks the puzzle for {lockout} seconds.

tutorial.title: Tallies, hints and the clock
tutorial.text: Finds and rooms earn Tallies. A wrong answer costs {wrong}. You have {hints} hints, {hint} Tallies each. The clock starts at 10:00 when you begin.

opening.text: The lift groaned and stopped. Dust fell like slow rain.
Above, the sky was turning orange.
Ren, get up. The Turning is ten minutes away.
The Hollow Court. Dessa's Journal says the Door is seven rooms out.
Then we start with the lift.
Good. You are a Runner already.
Ren stepped out. The walls began to creak.

idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

chalk_stub.name: Chalk Stub
chalk_stub.desc: A stub of white chalk. It draws lines on a map.

line.text: Chalk! Good for drawing on maps.

lever_handle.name: Lever Handle
lever_handle.desc: An iron handle. It fits a lever socket.

line.text: A lever handle. It should fit the post.

ruler.name: Ruler
ruler.desc: A wooden ruler with brass ends. It draws straight lines.

line.text: A ruler. Now my lines will be straight.

brass_pin.name: Brass Pin
brass_pin.desc: A small brass pin. It marks one spot on a map.

line.text: A brass pin. I can mark a spot with it.

brass_ball.name: Brass Ball
brass_ball.desc: A shiny brass ball. It rolls very well.

line.text: A brass ball. Where does it go?

socket_ring.name: Socket Ring
socket_ring.desc: An iron ring. It fits a round socket.

line.text: An iron ring. It looks like a socket part.

rusty_wrench.name: Rusty Wrench
rusty_wrench.desc: A rusty wrench. It can turn stuck bolts.

line.text: A wrench. A bit rusty, but it will work.

valve_spindle.name: Valve Spindle
valve_spindle.desc: A brass spindle. It is part of a valve.

line.text: A valve spindle. One part of the valve.

glow_lamp.name: Glow Lamp
glow_lamp.desc: A lantern with a green-blue flame. It lights dark rooms.

line.text: A glow lamp! It is still warm.

rope_spool.name: Rope Spool
rope_spool.desc: A thick spool of strong rope.

line.text: A spool of rope. Strong and thick.

name_cards.name: Name Cards
name_cards.desc: Six wooden cards, each with a name.

seal_ring.name: Seal Ring
seal_ring.desc: A heavy ring with a black stone. It opens a vault.

line.text: The seal ring. Cog is clever.

lever_grip.name: Lever Grip
lever_grip.desc: An iron grip for the great lever.

line.text: A lever grip. This is for the big lever.

runners_compass.name: Runner's Compass
runners_compass.desc: Shows which way is north. Runners never go without it.

wall_model.name: Wall Model
wall_model.desc: A small brass maze with a round cradle. A ball rolls inside.

valve_wheel.name: Valve Wheel
valve_wheel.desc: A big iron wheel. It opens a valve.

rope_hook.name: Rope Hook
rope_hook.desc: An iron hook for a rope. Good for a ravine.

archive_key.name: Archive Key
archive_key.desc: A big old key. It opens the Archive.

rule_card.name: Rule Card
rule_card.desc: A worn card with a pattern of dots. The Door wants this pattern.

N1.title: Crate Manifest
N1.text:
CRATE MANIFEST

Platform: 5 wide, 4 tall.
Crates:
- 1 square crate, 2 by 2. It is bolted in the top-left corner.
- 1 long crate, 4 in a row.
- 1 S crate.
- 1 L crate.
- 1 J crate.

The lift locks only when every square of the floor is covered.
Tap a crate to turn it. Drag it onto the floor.

N2.title: Bearing Note A
N2.teaches: A bearing is a direction in degrees.
N2.text:
BEARING NOTE A

The cache is hidden on a line that starts at the SPIRE.
From the Spire, look at bearing 135 degrees.

N3.title: Bearing Note B
N3.teaches: A second line gives a second bearing.
N3.text:
BEARING NOTE B

The cache is also on a line that starts at the OLD TREE.
From the Old Tree, look at bearing 270 degrees.

N4.title: Bearing Guide
N4.text:
BEARING GUIDE

Bearings turn clockwise from north.
North is 0. East is 90. South is 180. West is 270.
In between: 45 is north-east, 135 is south-east, 225 is south-west, 315 is north-west.

The map has columns A to I (left to right) and rows 1 to 9 (bottom to top). North is up.
The cache is where the two lines cross.

N5.title: Model Plate
N5.text:
MODEL PLATE

Tilt the model. The ball rolls until a wall or the edge stops it.
A pit swallows the ball. It goes back to the start.
The ball must fall into the exit hole.
The gate copies the ball.

N6.title: Valve Plate
N6.text:
VALVE PLATE

Water comes in at the top left. It leaves at the bottom right, through the sluice.
Tap a pipe to turn it.
Every pipe must join the next pipe. No open end is allowed.
Then open the valve.

N7.title: Ferryman's Board
N7.text:
FERRYMAN'S BOARD

The platform carries Ren and ONE thing. Only Ren can pull it.
If Ren is not on a bank, that bank must NOT hold:
- Cog with the lamp
- Cog with the spool
The lamp and the spool are safe together.
Get all three across.

N8.title: Seat Plates
N8.text:
SEAT PLATES

Seats 1 to 6 go clockwise. Seat 1 is under the skylight.
Opposite seats: 1 and 4, 2 and 5, 3 and 6.

1. Tamsin sits under the skylight (seat 1).
2. Sable sits directly across the table from Iven.
3. Orrel sits two seats clockwise of Iven.
4. Quill sits two seats clockwise of Tamsin.
5. Marro sits next to Tamsin.

VAULT LINE: The vault is the drawer numbered like Orrel's seat.

N9.title: Warden Rule
N9.text:
WARDEN RULE

Both ways open the Door.
The Door only asks who you stand for.

N10.title: Rule Card
N10.text:
RULE CARD

Set the nine lamps like this:

  ●  ●  ●
  ●  ○  ●
  ●  ●  ●

● = lit      ○ = dark

Each switch flips its own lamp and the lamps above, below, left and right of it.
Switches are numbered 1 to 9, left to right, top to bottom.

rooms.name: The Lift Yard
rooms.objective: Fill the lift platform so it locks.

enter.text: A lift with a locked floor. Why?
It locks only when it is full. Dessa packed it every dawn.

wrong.text: Not quite. Every crate must touch another or a wall.
Check the manifest. The square crate is bolted and stays put.
The long crate wants the bottom row. Fill around it.

hints.text: Start with the long crate. Put it along an edge.
Long crate flat on the bottom. The S crate fills the right corner.

right.text: The platform locked with a heavy clunk.
Dessa did that every morning.
There is a compass under the lever.
Take it. You will need north.

views.text: Tally marks, hundreds of them. Runners scratched one for every day they survived.
A hidden scratch in the corner:

hotspots.label: Lever post
hotspots.msg: The handle clicks into the socket.

rooms.name: The Mapmakers' Hut
rooms.objective: Find where the cache is hidden.

enter.text: Maps everywhere. And two landmarks in the window.
The Spire and the Old Tree. Runners measured from both.

wrong.text: No. One line is not enough. We need where two lines cross.
Read both notes. Each gives a bearing from one landmark.
Bearings run clockwise from north. East is 90, south is 180.

hints.text: Draw a line from the Spire and one from the Old Tree.
The Spire line runs down and right. The Tree line runs straight left. Where do they meet?

right.text: The pin sank into the map and a hatch clicked below.
A cache. Dessa's work.
A little brass maze with a ball slot.
A model of the gate walls. Keep it.

hotspots.label: Mapmakers' ledger

views.text: A thick ledger. Page after page of measurements and little drawings of the maze.
The last line of the last page:

hotspots.secret: The Door was built to be held.

hotspots.label: Table map
hotspots.msg: The compass rose appears on the map. North is up.

hotspots.label: Table map
hotspots.msg: You are ready to draw lines on the map.

rooms.name: The Moving Wall Gate
rooms.objective: Roll the ball into the exit hole.

enter.text: A gate as big as a hill, and a socket the size of my hand.
The model plugs in. The gate copies whatever the ball does.

wrong.text: The ball only stops at walls. Think where it will stop.
Read the Model Plate. Pits swallow the ball.
Go up the left edge first. Then use the wall at the top right.

hints.text: Plan one tilt at a time. Ask where the ball ends up.
Up to the top, then right until the wall stops it.

right.text: The slabs ground apart. Dust fell from the rails.
Dessa said it moves for those who plan.
There is a wheel on the frame.
A valve wheel. The cistern is next.

hotspots.label: Chalked slab

views.text: A slab with a chalk mark. The chalk is fresh. Something is hidden behind it.

hotspots.secret: Pits ahead. Roll around them. D.

hotspots.label: Brass panel
hotspots.msg: The ring locks in. The cradle opens.

hotspots.label: Brass panel
hotspots.msg: The model fits the cradle. The ball drops inside.

rooms.name: The Drowned Cistern
rooms.objective: Send the water out through the sluice.

enter.text: Black water, and a wall of pipes.
The sluice drains this place. If a pipe leaks, the Clatterers hear it.

wrong.text: A pipe with an open end leaks. Look for the red glow.
Read the Valve Plate. Every pipe must be joined, not just one path.
Follow the water in from the top left, one tile at a time.

hints.text: Follow the water from the top left. Fix the leak you can see.
The two empty squares are top right. Pipes there must turn away from them.

right.text: Water rushed out through the sluice and the pool sank.
A hook, stuck in the mud.
A rope hook. For a ravine?
Dessa kept it for the Ivy Corridor.

views.text: The front of the old pipe board. Rust everywhere.

hotspots.label: Pipe board
hotspots.msg: The wrench frees the bolts. The pipes can turn now.

hotspots.label: Valve pedestal
hotspots.msg: The wheel is on the pedestal. The pipe board has an Open valve button now.

rooms.name: The Ivy Corridor
rooms.objective: Get Cog, the lamp and the spool across.

enter.text: A ravine cut the corridor in two.
Ren! Hook the platform and send everything over. And that clicking is Cog. Never leave him alone with anything.

wrong.text: Something got wrecked. Cog cannot stay alone with the others.
Read the Ferryman's Board. Which two things are safe together?
Take Cog first. Then fetch the others, and bring Cog back once.

hints.text: Cog is the problem. Who can stay alone on a bank?
The lamp and the spool are safe together. Cog is never safe with either.

right.text: The platform bumped the far wall and the ivy stopped swaying.
Everyone made it. Even Cog.
A key on the post.
The Archive. Dessa's last stop.

hotspots.label: Near post
hotspots.msg: The hook catches the rope. The platform works now.

views.text: Something clicks inside the ivy. A tiny brass pup with a cracked lens eye looks out. It is Cog!

rooms.name: The Wardens' Archive
rooms.objective: Seat the Wardens and open the vault.

enter.text: It is pitch dark. I can hear dripping.
Light the lamp. The Wardens met here once.

wrong.text: Not that arrangement. Check each plate against your seats.
Begin with the skylight seat. One plate fixes it.
Tamsin first. Then count clockwise from her and from Iven.

hints.text: Put Tamsin in seat 1. Then use the clockwise clues.
Quill is two seats after Tamsin. Marro sits beside her. Where does Iven fit?

right.text: Runner. The Card is yours. The Door asks only that its lamps match.
And then?
Both ways open the Door. It only asks who you stand for.
I do not like that.

hotspots.label: Wall sconce
hotspots.msg: The lamp is lit. The archive glows purple.

hotspots.label: Old ledger

views.text: An old book on a high shelf. The Wardens kept it closed.

hotspots.secret: The Keeper counts one thing: who you stand for.

views.text: A high vent. Something shiny is stuck inside. Cog squeezes in... and comes back with a heavy ring!

hotspots.label: Drawer winch
hotspots.msg: The rope winds on. The drawer wall lowers.

hotspots.label: Drawers
hotspots.msg: The ring glows. Which drawer will you open?

enter.text: The hall was silent. Then the walls began to breathe.
And the Rule Card is the pattern.
Runner. Set the lamps as written. The Turning will not wait.

wrong.text: The walls! Back to the start. Think before you press.
Each switch flips five lamps, not one. Check the middle row.
Four switches are enough. One of them is the centre one.

hints.text: Compare the card with the board. Which lamps are wrong?
Switch 5 flips the centre lamp and its four neighbours. Start there.

right.text: The lamps burned gold. The walls stopped and groaned back.
It worked.
Now the lever. Whatever it does, we do it together.

choiceLines.text: The Door will open. You may hold the lever so that every gate in the Labyrinth opens with it. Or you may go through alone. Both open the Door.
I will not tell you what to do. I will be here either way.

views.text: A brass plaque on the Door. It is polished by many hands.

hotspots.label: Great lever
hotspots.msg: The grip locks onto the lever.

crate.title: Crate Fit
crate.help: Tap a crate to turn it. Drag it onto the floor. Fill every square.
crate.rules: Crates cannot overlap, stick out of the floor, or move the bolted crate. You can turn crates but not flip them.

triangulation.title: Triangulation
triangulation.help: Tap a landmark. Then pick a bearing to draw a chalk line.
triangulation.pinHelp: Tap a painted cache mark to place the pin.
triangulation.notMark: Pin only a painted cache mark.
triangulation.rules: You can only place the pin on a painted cache mark, and only after both lines are drawn.

tilt.title: Tilt Maze
tilt.help: Tilt the model. The ball rolls until a wall stops it.
tilt.pit: Pit! The ball goes back to the start.
tilt.win: The ball falls into the exit hole!
tilt.rules: You cannot stop the ball half way. It always rolls until a wall. Pits send it back to the start.

pipes.title: Pipe Flow
pipes.help: Tap a pipe to turn it. Red glow = open end. Blue = water.
pipes.noValve: The valve wheel is not on the pedestal yet.
pipes.rules: No pipe may have an open end (red glow). Do not open the valve until every pipe is joined, or the water leaks.

river.title: River Crossing
river.help: Step 1: tap one thing on Ren's bank to put it on the platform (or carry nothing). Step 2: press the Cross button.
river.wreck: Oh no! Cog wrecked something. Start again.
river.rules: The platform carries Ren and ONE thing only. Cog must never be left alone with the Glow Lamp or with the Rope Spool, or he wrecks it. The lamp and the spool are safe together.
river.warn: Careful! {a} and {b} would be left alone together. That is not allowed.
river.allDone: All safe on the far bank!

seating.title: Seating Plan
seating.help: Drag a name card to a seat. Or tap a card, then tap a seat. Seat 1 is under the skylight. Seats go clockwise.
seating.ok: The Wardens are seated. Now find the right drawer.
seating.rules: Each name sits in one seat only. All six seats must be filled before you press Check.

drawer.title: The Vault
drawer.help: Which drawer holds the vault? Think about Orrel's seat.
drawer.rules: Opening a wrong drawer costs Tallies and 10 seconds off the clock. Use the seat plates in your Journal first.

switch.title: The Switchboard
switch.help: Each switch flips its own lamp and the lamps above, below, left and right of it. The walls are closing!
switch.rules: You cannot flip one lamp alone. Every switch also flips the lamps next to it. If the walls close, you start again.

choice.title: The Choice
choice.help: Both choices open the Door. Pick the one you believe in.

options.text: Hold the lever. Every Runner goes free.
Go through alone. Ren steps out and the lever lets go.

A.title: The Gate Holder
A.sequel: Beyond the Door, Dessa waits. The real maze has barely begun.

lines.text: Ren held the lever with both hands. The Door swung open.
Far across the Labyrinth, gate after gate ground wide.
Ren? I knew you would hold it.
Beyond the Door. The real maze is out here.
Cog clicked and trotted ahead into a world with almost no walls in sight.

B.title: The Lone Runner
B.sequel: Behind the Door, Tali is already planning. The walls out here turn too.

lines.text: Ren let go of the lever. The Door opened for him alone.
Go. I will find a way.
One has left. Many remain. Test one is complete.
The Door closed behind Ren with a soft click.
Daylight. A hundred stone corridors stretched ahead.
Ren? You came. Quick, the walls out here turn too.
Somewhere behind the Door, Tali was already planning.
